offering_description.value: Provides IoT connectivity management platforms and cellular connectivity services to enterprises, letting them deploy, monitor and manage connected devices worldwide. Sells mainly by subscription and usage to businesses in automotive, healthcare, utilities and asset tracking.

primary_products.value: IoT SIM and eSIM connectivity; IoT connectivity management platform; device connectivity plans

primary_services.value: managed IoT connectivity; device provisioning and activation; IoT application enablement; data analytics for connected devices

customer_segment.value: B2B: enterprises in automotive, healthcare, utilities, asset tracking, security and fleet management

end_markets.value: automotive; healthcare; utilities; asset tracking; security; transportation and logistics

revenue_model.value: subscription: recurring fees for connectivity plans and platform access per device; transaction or usage fees: data usage charges for connected devices; service fees: professional services for device deployment and integration
revenue_model.category: subscription; transaction or usage fees; service fees

value_chain_position.value: service provider: provides managed cellular connectivity to enterprises that deploy IoT devices; software / platform: offers IoT device management software sold to enterprise customers

geography_served.value: global: customers and mobile network coverage across North America, Europe, Asia-Pacific and Latin America

specialization.value: niche specialist: focused on IoT connectivity, SIM and management platform offerings

distribution_channels.value: direct sales: enterprise sales teams serving large device makers and operators; partners / resellers: channel partners and system integrators that resell IoT connectivity

regulatory_exposure.value: medium: telecom spectrum and carrier rules, plus data privacy and security rules that apply to connected device data
